title: The Cricket
content_zh:
During the reign of an emperor who loved cricket-fighting, a poor farmer named Cheng Ming was ordered to provide champion crickets to the court as part of his tax. Unable to produce any, he was beaten and his family starved.
His young son, watching his father's despair, secretly went out to catch a cricket. He found a magnificent specimen. But while examining it, the cricket escaped and the boy crushed it in panic.
Terrified of punishment, the boy threw himself into a well and drowned. That night, his spirit transformed into a cricket — the finest fighting cricket ever seen. The cricket was sent to the emperor and won every match.
The emperor, overjoyed, rewarded Cheng Ming with gold and rank. But every night, Cheng Ming wept, because he knew his son's soul was trapped inside that tiny insect, fighting endlessly for imperial amusement.
